FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_LaserCleaving_DisplayGlassFocus
(*
========================================================================================================================
  PROJECT      : HIGH-THROUGHPUT ULTRA-THIN GLASS (UTG) LASER SEPARATING & CLEAVING WORKCELL
  SUBSYSTEM    : PICOSECOND BESSEL-BEAM FOCAL TRACKING & MECHANICAL WEDGE CONTROLLED SEPARATION
  DESIGNATION  : SIL-2 / CLASS I ULTRA-PRECISION CYBER-PHYSICAL OPTO-MECHATRONIC CONTROLLER
  SPECIFICATION: IEC 61131-3 3RD EDITION / SEMI E54 / ISA-88 STATE MACHINE / ISA-18.2 ALARMS
  AUTHOR       : PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS CHAIR (LUMINA SWARM)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  THEORETICAL AND CYBER-PHYSICAL CONTROL ARCHITECTURE:
  This function block coordinates the non-ablative laser modified filamentation and subsequent mechanical tension-cleave
  separation of flexible display substrates (thickness 30.0 um to 70.0 um aluminosilicate / borosilicate UTG).
  
  1. OPTICAL FILAMENTATION PROPAGATION DYNAMICS (PICOSECOND BURST REGIME):
     A quasi-diffraction-free zero-order Bessel-Gauss beam (cone half-angle theta ~ 14 deg, wavelength lambda = 1064 nm)
     is generated using a high-numerical-aperture axicon telecentric objective. The high peak irradiance (> 1.0e13 W/cm2)
     triggers non-linear optical multi-photon absorption and avalanche ionization along a narrow internal cylindrical
     filament channel (diameter d ~ 1.2 um to 1.8 um) traversing the glass thickness without ablating surface layers.
     Refraction across the air-glass boundary introduces focal plane shifts governed by:
         z_interior = z_air * sqrt((n_glass^2 - sin^2(theta_0)) / cos^2(theta_0))
     where nominal refractive index n_glass = 1.5170 at 1064 nm.
     
  2. DYNAMIC FOCAL DEPTH TRACKING VIA FAST PIEZOELECTRIC FLEXURE (CLOSED-LOOP Z):
     Substrate bow, vacuum-chuck planarity undulations, and dynamic aerodynamic flutter induce Z-disturbances during
     gantry traversal at velocities up to 800.0 mm/s. A piezo-actuated objective flexure (travel 0..100 um, resonant
     frequency 1.8 kHz) executes real-time focal tracking. To prevent optical focal waist wandering out of the 
     substrate thickness window (+/- 2.5 um tolerance), the controller executes:
       a) 2oo3 (Two-Out-Of-Three) Triple Modular Redundant (TMR) Confocal Chromatic Sensor Triangulation.
       b) Discrete-Time State-Space Kalman Estimator (tracking surface position, velocity, and periodic chuck waviness).
       c) Receding Horizon Model Predictive Control (MPC) with look-ahead feedforward and piezo slew-rate bounds.
       d) Dynamic Thermo-Optic Drift Compensation compensating laser housing thermal expansion (alpha ~ 23.5e-6 / K)
          and glass temperature changes.
          
  3. CONTROLLED MECHANICAL WEDGE TENSIONING (LINEAR ELASTIC FRACTURE MECHANICS - LEFM):
     Subsequent to picosecond filamentation scoring, an ultra-stiff diamond/carbide wedge blade applies controlled
     tensile stress perpendicular to the cleave plane. Mode I crack propagation follows the Griffith-Irwin criterion:
         K_I = sigma_applied * sqrt(pi * a_crack) >= K_Ic
     where critical stress intensity factor K_Ic = 0.75 MPa*m^(1/2) for borosilicate display glass.
     Excessive force causes uncontrolled crack branching, edge micro-chipping, and sub-surface flaking (Rz > 0.2 um).
     Insufficient force stalls median crack propagation. The block commands a closed-loop voice-coil wedge drive
     implementing dynamic stiffness profiling, load-cell strain feedback, and acoustic emission rate monitoring.
     
  4. FAULT MANAGEMENT & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION:
     Implements automated sensor health voting (2oo3 -> 1oo2 -> 1oo1 -> Safe Trip), thermal envelope bounding,
     vacuum hold verification, and interlocked beam dump shuttering in accordance with IEC 62061 / ISO 13849-1.
========================================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* Master Interlocks and Safety Permissives *)
    bEnable                     : BOOL;     (* Master process enable permissive signal (from safety PLC) *)
    bEmergencyStop              : BOOL;     (* SIL-3 dual-channel safety circuit status: TRUE = Healthy, FALSE = E-Stop *)
    bLaserReady                 : BOOL;     (* Picosecond laser source status ready, emission shutter operational *)
    bInterlockEnclosure         : BOOL;     (* Laser safety enclosure Class 4 interlock circuit: TRUE = Sealed *)
    bAutoWedgeEngage            : BOOL;     (* Permissive to engage mechanical cleaving wedge after laser scoring *)
    bResetFault                 : BOOL;     (* Master fault acknowledgment and alarm reset edge *)

    (* Substrate Kinematics and Geometry *)
    rTraverseVelocity_mms       : REAL;     (* Current linear feedrate of gantry along cleave path [mm/s] (0.0 .. 1000.0) *)
    rTraversePos_mm             : REAL;     (* Current gantry X-position along cleave line [mm] *)
    rGlassThickness_um          : REAL;     (* Nominal substrate thickness [um] (25.0 .. 150.0) *)
    rGlassRefractiveIndex       : REAL;     (* Substrate optical refractive index at 1064 nm (e.g., 1.5050 .. 1.5450) *)

    (* Laser Process Energetics *)
    rLaserPulseEnergy_uJ        : REAL;     (* Measured picosecond burst pulse energy [uJ] (10.0 .. 150.0) *)
    rLaserRepRate_kHz           : REAL;     (* Pulse repetition frequency [kHz] (50.0 .. 1000.0) *)

    (* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundant (TMR) Confocal Chromatic Surface Sensors *)
    rZSensorRaw_A_um            : REAL;     (* Optical Confocal Sensor Channel A raw distance reading [um] *)
    rZSensorRaw_B_um            : REAL;     (* Optical Confocal Sensor Channel B raw distance reading [um] *)
    rZSensorRaw_C_um            : REAL;     (* Optical Confocal Sensor Channel C raw distance reading [um] *)

    (* Mechanical Cleaving and Tooling Feedback *)
    rWedgeForceFeedback_N       : REAL;     (* Strain-gauge load cell feedback of cleaving wedge tension [N] (0.0 .. 15.0) *)
    rAcousticEmission_mV        : REAL;     (* Piezoelectric acoustic emission sensor measuring crack propagation transients [mV] *)

    (* Environmental, Thermal, and Pneumatic Auxiliary Interlocks *)
    rVacuumChuckPressure_kPa    : REAL;     (* Porous ceramic vacuum chuck negative pressure [-kPa] (Nominal: -80 to -98) *)
    rOpticHeadTemp_DegC         : REAL;     (* Telecentric axicon lens assembly optical barrel temperature [deg C] (18..35) *)
    rGasPurgeFlow_lmin          : REAL;     (* Coaxial nitrogen laminar purge flow for debris suppression [l/min] (15..50) *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* Operational and Safety Handshake Outputs *)
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* Workcell fully synchronized, calibrated, and ready for cycle *)
    bLaserEmissionEnable        : BOOL;     (* Hardware gate permissive to picosecond laser trigger generator *)
    bWedgeClampingActive        : BOOL;     (* Wedge drive servo/voice-coil enabled and tracking tension *)
    bDegradedModeActive         : BOOL;     (* True if operating under 1oo2 or single-sensor degraded resilience *)
    bCleaveCycleComplete        : BOOL;     (* Strobe signal on verified completion of cleave cycle *)
    bSystemFaultTrip            : BOOL;     (* Master latching fault output requiring operator intervention *)

    (* Actuator Drives and Dynamic Setpoints *)
    rPiezoFocusDrive_um         : REAL;     (* High-speed analog command to piezo flexure Z-amplifier [um] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rWedgeTensionDrive_N        : REAL;     (* Force command to voice-coil wedge cleaving actuator [N] (0.0 .. 12.0) *)

    (* Process Telemetry and Physical State Observers *)
    rEstimatedFocalDepth_um     : REAL;     (* Kalman-filtered internal filamentation waist location [um] *)
    rVotedSurfaceZ_um           : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR consolidated surface Z-datum [um] *)
    rCrackPropagationSpeed_mms  : REAL;     (* Estimated median crack velocity from acoustic emission [mm/s] *)
    rSurfaceResidualWaviness_um : REAL;     (* Real-time Root-Mean-Square (RMS) substrate undulation error [um] *)

    (* Diagnostic and Alarm Words *)
    wSystemStatusWord           : WORD;     (* ISA-88 system operational phase status word *)
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord        : DWORD;    (* ISA-18.2 multi-tiered diagnostic and alarm fault bit-field *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       ISA-88 State Machine Control & Sequencing
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    iState                      : INT := 0;     (* Current state machine pointer *)
    iPrevState                  : INT := 0;     (* Previous state machine pointer *)
    tonStateTimer               : TON;          (* General state timeout monitor *)
    tonVacuumSettle             : TON;          (* Chuck vacuum stabilization timer *)
    tonPurgeVerify              : TON;          (* Nitrogen purge flow stabilization timer *)
    tonLaserWarmupVerify        : TON;          (* Laser power stability verification timer *)
    tonWedgeRampTimer           : TON;          (* Mechanical wedge tension dwell timer *)

    (* Edge Detection Triggers *)
    rTrigReset                  : R_TRIG;       (* Fault reset positive edge trigger *)
    rTrigEnable                 : R_TRIG;       (* Master enable positive edge trigger *)
    fTrigLaserOk                : F_TRIG;       (* Laser source falling edge fault trigger *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       2oo3 Triple Modular Redundant (TMR) Sensor Voting Engine
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    bSensorA_Healthy            : BOOL := TRUE; (* Sensor A operational status *)
    bSensorB_Healthy            : BOOL := TRUE; (* Sensor B operational status *)
    bSensorC_Healthy            : BOOL := TRUE; (* Sensor C operational status *)
    iHealthySensorCount         : INT  := 3;    (* Active healthy sensor tally (3, 2, 1, 0) *)
    rDiscrepancyThreshold_um    : REAL := 0.85; (* Discrepancy window for 2oo3 deviation [um] *)
    rHardSensorLimitMin_um      : REAL := 5.0;  (* Minimum allowable physical sensor reading [um] *)
    rHardSensorLimitMax_um      : REAL := 95.0; (* Maximum allowable physical sensor reading [um] *)
    rDiffAB_um                  : REAL;         (* |Sensor A - Sensor B| [um] *)
    rDiffBC_um                  : REAL;         (* |Sensor B - Sensor C| [um] *)
    rDiffCA_um                  : REAL;         (* |Sensor C - Sensor A| [um] *)
    tonSensorADebounce          : TON;          (* Persistent drift debounce Sensor A *)
    tonSensorBDebounce          : TON;          (* Persistent drift debounce Sensor B *)
    tonSensorCDebounce          : TON;          (* Persistent drift debounce Sensor C *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Kalman Filter / State-Space Observer for Glass Topography & Vibration
       Discrete state model: x(k+1) = A*x(k) + B*u(k) + w(k); y(k) = C*x(k) + v(k)
       x[1] = Surface Height Z [um]
       x[2] = Surface Vertical Slope / Velocity dZ/dt [um/ms]
       x[3] = High-Frequency Acoustic/Waviness Disturbance d^2Z/dt^2 [um/ms^2]
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rX1_Pos_um                  : REAL := 50.0; (* State x1 estimate: Surface position [um] *)
    rX2_Vel_um_ms               : REAL := 0.0;  (* State x2 estimate: Vertical velocity [um/ms] *)
    rX3_Dist_um_ms2             : REAL := 0.0;  (* State x3 estimate: Disturbance acceleration [um/ms^2] *)
    
    (* Error Covariance Matrix P (Symmetric 3x3) *)
    rP11                        : REAL := 1.0;
    rP12                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rP13                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rP22                        : REAL := 1.0;
    rP23                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rP33                        : REAL := 1.0;

    (* Process Noise Covariance Q and Measurement Noise R *)
    rQ11                        : REAL := 0.005; (* Position process noise variance *)
    rQ22                        : REAL := 0.020; (* Velocity process noise variance *)
    rQ33                        : REAL := 0.080; (* Acceleration/vibration noise variance *)
    rR_Noise                    : REAL := 0.040; (* Optical confocal sensor measurement noise variance *)

    (* Kalman Innovations & Gains *)
    rKalmanInnov_um             : REAL := 0.0;
    rKalmanGain1                : REAL := 0.0;
    rKalmanGain2                : REAL := 0.0;
    rKalmanGain3                : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaT_ms                  : REAL := 1.0;   (* Discrete scan cycle interval: 1.0 ms (1000 Hz) *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Model Predictive Control (MPC) Horizon & Piezo Tracking Drive
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rFocalPlaneTargetOffset_um  : REAL := 25.0;  (* Nominal focal waist depth below glass surface [um] *)
    rZ_ThermalOffset_um         : REAL := 0.0;   (* Dynamic thermal expansion focus correction [um] *)
    rPiezoCmdUnconstrained_um   : REAL := 50.0;  (* Raw unconstrained MPC control output [um] *)
    rPiezoCmdFiltered_um        : REAL := 50.0;  (* Rate-limited piezo drive output [um] *)
    rPiezoMaxSlewRate_um_ms     : REAL := 3.5;   (* Maximum allowable piezo actuator rate [um/ms] *)
    rPiezoStrokeMin_um          : REAL := 2.0;   (* Piezo hard minimum travel limit [um] *)
    rPiezoStrokeMax_um          : REAL := 98.0;  (* Piezo hard maximum travel limit [um] *)

    (* Look-Ahead Horizon Vectors (Np = 3 steps) *)
    rRefLookAhead_1             : REAL := 50.0;
    rRefLookAhead_2             : REAL := 50.0;
    rRefLookAhead_3             : REAL := 50.0;

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics (LEFM) & Wedge Tensioning
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rGlassYoungsModulus_GPa     : REAL := 72.8;  (* Elastic modulus of aluminosilicate UTG [GPa] *)
    rGlassPoissonRatio          : REAL := 0.22;  (* Poisson ratio of display glass *)
    rCriticalStressIntensity_MPa: REAL := 0.76;  (* Mode I fracture toughness K_Ic [MPa*m^0.5] *)
    rWedgeTargetForce_N         : REAL := 2.50;  (* Dynamic target cleaving tension [N] *)
    rWedgeForceError_N          : REAL := 0.0;   (* Force control deviation [N] *)
    rWedgeForceIntegral_N       : REAL := 0.0;   (* Force control integral accumulator [N*s] *)
    rWedgeKp                    : REAL := 1.85;  (* Proportional gain for wedge voice-coil drive *)
    rWedgeKi                    : REAL := 0.45;  (* Integral gain for wedge voice-coil drive *)
    rWedgeForceMaxAllowed_N     : REAL := 8.50;  (* Hard safety threshold preventing glass shattering [N] *)
    rAcousticEventThreshold_mV  : REAL := 85.0;  (* Acoustic emission threshold detecting crack initiation [mV] *)

    (* Residual Waviness Moving RMS Accumulator *)
    aWavinessWindow             : ARRAY[1..10] OF REAL;
    iWavinessIndex              : INT := 1;
    rWavinessSumSquare          : REAL := 0.0;
    iLoopCounter                : INT;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  SAFETY INTERLOCK SUPERVISOR & FAULT TRIP LATCH (ISA-18.2 / SIL-2 HARD MATRIX)
========================================================================================================================
*)
rTrigReset(CLK := bResetFault);
rTrigEnable(CLK := bEnable);
fTrigLaserOk(CLK := bLaserReady);

(* Fault Reset Logic *)
IF rTrigReset.Q THEN
    bSystemFaultTrip := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord := 16#00000000;
    bSensorA_Healthy := TRUE;
    bSensorB_Healthy := TRUE;
    bSensorC_Healthy := TRUE;
    rWedgeForceIntegral_N := 0.0;
    iState := 0; (* Return to Idle Standby *)
END_IF;

(* Critical Emergency Stop Condition *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.0 := TRUE; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Asserted *)
    iState := 99; (* Transition immediately to safe extinction stop *)
END_IF;

(* Laser Safety Enclosure Interlock Violation *)
IF NOT bInterlockEnclosure THEN
    bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.1 := TRUE; (* Bit 1: Enclosure Interlock Breached *)
    iState := 99;
END_IF;

(* Picosecond Laser Source Dropped Ready Signal During Process *)
IF fTrigLaserOk.Q AND (iState >= 40) THEN
    bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.2 := TRUE; (* Bit 2: Laser Source Hardware Fault *)
    iState := 99;
END_IF;

(* Vacuum Chuck Hold-Down Loss *)
IF (rVacuumChuckPressure_kPa > -65.0) AND (iState >= 20) AND (iState <= 60) THEN
    bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.3 := TRUE; (* Bit 3: Vacuum Substrate Clamping Loss *)
    iState := 99;
END_IF;

(* Optical Head Thermal Runaway Envelope Monitoring *)
IF (rOpticHeadTemp_DegC < 16.0) OR (rOpticHeadTemp_DegC > 38.0) THEN
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.4 := TRUE; (* Bit 4: Optic Head Temperature Boundary Exceeded *)
    IF (rOpticHeadTemp_DegC > 45.0) THEN
        bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
        iState := 99;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Nitrogen Laminar Purge Flow Monitoring *)
IF (rGasPurgeFlow_lmin < 12.0) AND (iState >= 40) THEN
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.5 := TRUE; (* Bit 5: Laminar Purge Flow Depleted *)
    bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
    iState := 99;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Mechanical Cleaving Wedge Over-Force Protection *)
IF (rWedgeForceFeedback_N > rWedgeForceMaxAllowed_N) THEN
    bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.6 := TRUE; (* Bit 6: Wedge Cleaving Over-Force Griffith Violation *)
    iState := 99;
END_IF;


(*
========================================================================================================================
  2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANT (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & DISCREPANCY ARBITRATION
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Individual Sensor Range Verification *)
IF (rZSensorRaw_A_um < rHardSensorLimitMin_um) OR (rZSensorRaw_A_um > rHardSensorLimitMax_um) THEN
    bSensorA_Healthy := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.8 := TRUE; (* Bit 8: Sensor A Out-of-Range *)
END_IF;

IF (rZSensorRaw_B_um < rHardSensorLimitMin_um) OR (rZSensorRaw_B_um > rHardSensorLimitMax_um) THEN
    bSensorB_Healthy := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.9 := TRUE; (* Bit 9: Sensor B Out-of-Range *)
END_IF;

IF (rZSensorRaw_C_um < rHardSensorLimitMin_um) OR (rZSensorRaw_C_um > rHardSensorLimitMax_um) THEN
    bSensorC_Healthy := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.10 := TRUE; (* Bit 10: Sensor C Out-of-Range *)
END_IF;

(* Cross-Sensor Differential Discrepancy Evaluation *)
rDiffAB_um := ABS(rZSensorRaw_A_um - rZSensorRaw_B_um);
rDiffBC_um := ABS(rZSensorRaw_B_um - rZSensorRaw_C_um);
rDiffCA_um := ABS(rZSensorRaw_C_um - rZSensorRaw_A_um);

(* Debounce Discrepancy Alarms (50 ms persistent deviation) *)
tonSensorADebounce(IN := (rDiffAB_um > rDiscrepancyThreshold_um) AND (rDiffCA_um > rDiscrepancyThreshold_um), PT := T#50MS);
tonSensorBDebounce(IN := (rDiffAB_um > rDiscrepancyThreshold_um) AND (rDiffBC_um > rDiscrepancyThreshold_um), PT := T#50MS);
tonSensorCDebounce(IN := (rDiffBC_um > rDiscrepancyThreshold_um) AND (rDiffCA_um > rDiscrepancyThreshold_um), PT := T#50MS);

IF tonSensorADebounce.Q THEN
    bSensorA_Healthy := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.11 := TRUE; (* Bit 11: Sensor A Cross-Channel Discrepancy *)
END_IF;

IF tonSensorBDebounce.Q THEN
    bSensorB_Healthy := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.12 := TRUE; (* Bit 12: Sensor B Cross-Channel Discrepancy *)
END_IF;

IF tonSensorCDebounce.Q THEN
    bSensorC_Healthy := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.13 := TRUE; (* Bit 13: Sensor C Cross-Channel Discrepancy *)
END_IF;

(* Tally Healthy Operational Channels *)
iHealthySensorCount := 0;
IF bSensorA_Healthy THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bSensorB_Healthy THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bSensorC_Healthy THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Voting Arbitration & Degradation State Tree *)
CASE iHealthySensorCount OF
    3: (* Pristine 2oo3 Voting Mode - Median Calculation *)
        bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
        wDiagnosticAlarmWord.14 := FALSE; (* Bit 14: Degraded Mode Indication *)
        
        IF ((rZSensorRaw_A_um >= rZSensorRaw_B_um) AND (rZSensorRaw_A_um <= rZSensorRaw_C_um)) OR 
           ((rZSensorRaw_A_um >= rZSensorRaw_C_um) AND (rZSensorRaw_A_um <= rZSensorRaw_B_um)) THEN
            rVotedSurfaceZ_um := rZSensorRaw_A_um;
        ELSIF ((rZSensorRaw_B_um >= rZSensorRaw_A_um) AND (rZSensorRaw_B_um <= rZSensorRaw_C_um)) OR 
              ((rZSensorRaw_B_um >= rZSensorRaw_C_um) AND (rZSensorRaw_B_um <= rZSensorRaw_A_um)) THEN
            rVotedSurfaceZ_um := rZSensorRaw_B_um;
        ELSE
            rVotedSurfaceZ_um := rZSensorRaw_C_um;
        END_IF;

    2: (* Degraded 1oo2 Redundant Mode - Average of Surviving Pair *)
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        wDiagnosticAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
        
        IF bSensorA_Healthy AND bSensorB_Healthy THEN
            rVotedSurfaceZ_um := (rZSensorRaw_A_um + rZSensorRaw_B_um) * 0.5;
        ELSIF bSensorB_Healthy AND bSensorC_Healthy THEN
            rVotedSurfaceZ_um := (rZSensorRaw_B_um + rZSensorRaw_C_um) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            rVotedSurfaceZ_um := (rZSensorRaw_A_um + rZSensorRaw_C_um) * 0.5;
        END_IF;

    1: (* Highly Degraded 1oo1 Mode - Single Sensor Fallback with Severe Feedrate Clamping *)
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
        wDiagnosticAlarmWord.14 := TRUE;
        wDiagnosticAlarmWord.15 := TRUE; (* Bit 15: Critical Single Sensor Fallback *)
        
        IF bSensorA_Healthy THEN
            rVotedSurfaceZ_um := rZSensorRaw_A_um;
        ELSIF bSensorB_Healthy THEN
            rVotedSurfaceZ_um := rZSensorRaw_B_um;
        ELSE
            rVotedSurfaceZ_um := rZSensorRaw_C_um;
        END_IF;

    0: (* Total Sensor Triangulation Failure - Immediate Controlled Trip *)
        bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
        wDiagnosticAlarmWord.16 := TRUE; (* Bit 16: Complete Loss of Surface Tracking TMR *)
        iState := 99;
END_CASE;


(*
========================================================================================================================
  DISCRETE-TIME KALMAN FILTER (TOPOGRAPHY OBSERVER & SENSOR FUSION)
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Time Update (A Priori State Propagation):
   x1(k+1|k) = x1(k|k) + dt*x2(k|k) + 0.5*dt^2*x3(k|k)
   x2(k+1|k) = x2(k|k) + dt*x3(k|k)
   x3(k+1|k) = 0.98 * x3(k|k)  (* Damped vibration disturbance decay *)
*)
rX1_Pos_um      := rX1_Pos_um + (rDeltaT_ms * rX2_Vel_um_ms) + (0.5 * rDeltaT_ms * rDeltaT_ms * rX3_Dist_um_ms2);
rX2_Vel_um_ms   := rX2_Vel_um_ms + (rDeltaT_ms * rX3_Dist_um_ms2);
rX3_Dist_um_ms2 := rX3_Dist_um_ms2 * 0.985;

(* Covariance Extrapolation: P = A*P*A' + Q *)
rP11 := rP11 + (2.0 * rDeltaT_ms * rP12) + (rDeltaT_ms * rDeltaT_ms * rP22) + rQ11;
rP12 := rP12 + (rDeltaT_ms * rP22) + (rDeltaT_ms * rP13);
rP22 := rP22 + (2.0 * rDeltaT_ms * rP23) + rQ22;
rP33 := (rP33 * 0.970) + rQ33;

(* Measurement Innovation (Residual): y - C*x *)
rKalmanInnov_um := rVotedSurfaceZ_um - rX1_Pos_um;

(* Kalman Gain Computation: K = P*C' / (C*P*C' + R) *)
rKalmanGain1 := rP11 / (rP11 + rR_Noise);
rKalmanGain2 := rP12 / (rP11 + rR_Noise);
rKalmanGain3 := rP13 / (rP11 + rR_Noise);

(* Measurement Update (A Posteriori State Estimation): x = x + K*innov *)
rX1_Pos_um      := rX1_Pos_um + (rKalmanGain1 * rKalmanInnov_um);
rX2_Vel_um_ms   := rX2_Vel_um_ms + (rKalmanGain2 * rKalmanInnov_um);
rX3_Dist_um_ms2 := rX3_Dist_um_ms2 + (rKalmanGain3 * rKalmanInnov_um);

(* Covariance Correction: P = (I - K*C)*P *)
rP11 := (1.0 - rKalmanGain1) * rP11;
rP12 := (1.0 - rKalmanGain1) * rP12;
rP22 := rP22 - (rKalmanGain2 * rP12);
rP33 := rP33 - (rKalmanGain3 * rP13);

(* Real-Time RMS Substrate Residual Waviness Calculation *)
rWavinessSumSquare := rWavinessSumSquare - (aWavinessWindow[iWavinessIndex] * aWavinessWindow[iWavinessIndex]);
aWavinessWindow[iWavinessIndex] := rKalmanInnov_um;
rWavinessSumSquare := rWavinessSumSquare + (rKalmanInnov_um * rKalmanInnov_um);

iWavinessIndex := iWavinessIndex + 1;
IF iWavinessIndex > 10 THEN
    iWavinessIndex := 1;
END_IF;

IF rWavinessSumSquare > 0.0 THEN
    rSurfaceResidualWaviness_um := SQRT(rWavinessSumSquare / 10.0);
ELSE
    rSurfaceResidualWaviness_um := 0.0;
END_IF;


(*
========================================================================================================================
  DYNAMIC OPTICAL CORRECTION & MODEL PREDICTIVE FOCUS DRIVE COMPUTATION
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Dynamic Thermo-Optic Lens Barrel Expansion Offset:
   Expansion = L0 * alpha_barrel * (T_actual - T_nominal) + (dn/dT * d_focal)
*)
rZ_ThermalOffset_um := (rOpticHeadTemp_DegC - 22.0) * 0.425;

(* Optical Substrate Refraction Depth Compensation:
   Focal waist interior target relative to physical glass top surface:
   z_interior = z_surface + (rFocalPlaneTargetOffset_um / rGlassRefractiveIndex)
*)
rEstimatedFocalDepth_um := rX1_Pos_um + (rFocalPlaneTargetOffset_um / MAX(1.0, rGlassRefractiveIndex));

(* MPC Trajectory Look-Ahead (Prediction Horizon Np = 3 ms) *)
rRefLookAhead_1 := rX1_Pos_um + (1.0 * rDeltaT_ms * rX2_Vel_um_ms) + rZ_ThermalOffset_um;
rRefLookAhead_2 := rX1_Pos_um + (2.0 * rDeltaT_ms * rX2_Vel_um_ms) + rZ_ThermalOffset_um;
rRefLookAhead_3 := rX1_Pos_um + (3.0 * rDeltaT_ms * rX2_Vel_um_ms) + rZ_ThermalOffset_um;

(* Weighted Receding Horizon Control Synthesis (Cost Function Minimization):
   Min J = sum(w_p * (y_k+j - r_k+j)^2) + w_u * (delta_u)^2
*)
rPiezoCmdUnconstrained_um := (0.55 * rRefLookAhead_1) + (0.30 * rRefLookAhead_2) + (0.15 * rRefLookAhead_3);

(* Slew Rate Clamping (Protects flexure piezo crystal from excessive dV/dt polarization shock) *)
IF (rPiezoCmdUnconstrained_um - rPiezoCmdFiltered_um) > (rPiezoMaxSlewRate_um_ms * rDeltaT_ms) THEN
    rPiezoCmdFiltered_um := rPiezoCmdFiltered_um + (rPiezoMaxSlewRate_um_ms * rDeltaT_ms);
ELSIF (rPiezoCmdUnconstrained_um - rPiezoCmdFiltered_um) < (-rPiezoMaxSlewRate_um_ms * rDeltaT_ms) THEN
    rPiezoCmdFiltered_um := rPiezoCmdFiltered_um - (rPiezoMaxSlewRate_um_ms * rDeltaT_ms);
ELSE
    rPiezoCmdFiltered_um := rPiezoCmdUnconstrained_um;
END_IF;

(* Bounding to Physical Actuator Stroke Envelope (2.0 .. 98.0 um) *)
IF rPiezoCmdFiltered_um > rPiezoStrokeMax_um THEN
    rPiezoFocusDrive_um := rPiezoStrokeMax_um;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.17 := TRUE; (* Bit 17: Piezo Stroke High Saturation *)
ELSIF rPiezoCmdFiltered_um < rPiezoStrokeMin_um THEN
    rPiezoFocusDrive_um := rPiezoStrokeMin_um;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.18 := TRUE; (* Bit 18: Piezo Stroke Low Saturation *)
ELSE
    rPiezoFocusDrive_um := rPiezoCmdFiltered_um;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.17 := FALSE;
    wDiagnosticAlarmWord.18 := FALSE;
END_IF;


(*
========================================================================================================================
  LEFM MECHANICAL CLEAVING WEDGE TENSIONING REGULATOR
========================================================================================================================
*)
(* Fracture Velocity Estimation from Acoustic Emission Transients *)
IF rAcousticEmission_mV > rAcousticEventThreshold_mV THEN
    (* Higher acoustic ringing translates to dynamic crack front speed [mm/s] *)
    rCrackPropagationSpeed_mms := (rAcousticEmission_mV - rAcousticEventThreshold_mV) * 3.42;
ELSE
    rCrackPropagationSpeed_mms := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Griffith-Irwin Mode I Closed-Loop Tensioning:
   Tension demand adjusts adaptively to current crack propagation dynamics.
*)
IF (iState = 50) THEN
    (* Dynamic wedge setpoint calculation based on glass thickness *)
    rWedgeTargetForce_N := (rGlassThickness_um / 50.0) * 2.85;
    
    (* If crack propagation stalls, modulate setpoint smoothly to resume cleavage *)
    IF (rCrackPropagationSpeed_mms < 10.0) AND (tonWedgeRampTimer.ET > T#200MS) THEN
        rWedgeTargetForce_N := rWedgeTargetForce_N + 0.45;
    END_IF;

    rWedgeForceError_N := rWedgeTargetForce_N - rWedgeForceFeedback_N;
    
    (* PI Force Control with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
    rWedgeForceIntegral_N := rWedgeForceIntegral_N + (rWedgeKi * rWedgeForceError_N * (rDeltaT_ms / 1000.0));
    IF rWedgeForceIntegral_N > 3.0 THEN rWedgeForceIntegral_N := 3.0; END_IF;
    IF rWedgeForceIntegral_N < -1.0 THEN rWedgeForceIntegral_N := -1.0; END_IF;

    rWedgeTensionDrive_N := (rWedgeKp * rWedgeForceError_N) + rWedgeForceIntegral_N;
    
    (* Force Clamping *)
    IF rWedgeTensionDrive_N > 8.0 THEN rWedgeTensionDrive_N := 8.0; END_IF;
    IF rWedgeTensionDrive_N < 0.0 THEN rWedgeTensionDrive_N := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rWedgeForceIntegral_N := 0.0;
    rWedgeTensionDrive_N  := 0.0;
END_IF;


(*
========================================================================================================================
  ISA-88 STATE MACHINE EXECUTION & PROCESS SEQUENCING
========================================================================================================================
*)
tonStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#30S);
iPrevState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & STANDBY PARK
          ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0001; (* STATUS: STANDBY *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bLaserEmissionEnable        := FALSE;
        bWedgeClampingActive        := FALSE;
        bCleaveCycleComplete        := FALSE;
        rPiezoCmdFiltered_um        := 50.0; (* Retract to mid-stroke datum *)

        IF bEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND bLaserReady AND bInterlockEnclosure AND NOT bSystemFaultTrip THEN
            iState := 10; (* Advance to Hardware & Sensor Self-Check *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 10: HARDWARE INTEGRITY & 2oo3 CALIBRATION VERIFICATION
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0002; (* STATUS: SELF-TEST & CALIBRATION *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bLaserEmissionEnable        := FALSE;

        (* Verify that at least 2 sensors are healthy and in valid physical range *)
        IF (iHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND (rLaserPulseEnergy_uJ >= 25.0) THEN
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Substrate Vacuum Clamping *)
        ELSIF tonStateTimer.Q THEN
            bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
            wDiagnosticAlarmWord.20 := TRUE; (* Bit 20: Self-Test Timeout *)
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    20: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 20: VACUUM CHUCK CHOP & SUBSTRATE FLATTENING
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0004; (* STATUS: VACUUM HOLD DOWN *)
        tonVacuumSettle(IN := (rVacuumChuckPressure_kPa <= -82.0), PT := T#400MS);
        tonPurgeVerify(IN := (rGasPurgeFlow_lmin >= 20.0), PT := T#300MS);

        IF tonVacuumSettle.Q AND tonPurgeVerify.Q THEN
            iState := 30; (* Advance to Surface Pre-Scan / Baseline Registration *)
        ELSIF tonStateTimer.Q THEN
            bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
            wDiagnosticAlarmWord.21 := TRUE; (* Bit 21: Vacuum Stabilization Failed *)
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    30: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 30: PRE-SCAN TOPOGRAPHY REGISTRATION & SYSTEM ARMED
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0008; (* STATUS: ARMED FOR EMISSION *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;

        (* Trigger laser emission if gantry feedrate reaches cutting speed threshold *)
        IF (rTraverseVelocity_mms >= 50.0) AND bEnable THEN
            iState := 40; (* Enter Synchronized Picosecond Filamentation Cleave *)
        ELSIF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 40: SYNCHRONIZED PICOSECOND LASER FILAMENTATION
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0010; (* STATUS: LASER EMISSION ACTIVE *)
        bLaserEmissionEnable        := TRUE;
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;

        (* Check if gantry has completed the programmed cleave vector traverse *)
        IF (rTraversePos_mm >= 150.0) OR ((rTraverseVelocity_mms < 10.0) AND (tonStateTimer.ET > T#1S)) THEN
            bLaserEmissionEnable    := FALSE;
            IF bAutoWedgeEngage THEN
                iState := 50; (* Transition directly to Mechanical Wedge Cleave *)
            ELSE
                iState := 60; (* Bypass wedge to post-inspection *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    50: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 50: CONTROLLED MECHANICAL WEDGE TENSIONING & CLEAVING
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0020; (* STATUS: WEDGE TENSIONING ACTIVE *)
        bLaserEmissionEnable        := FALSE;
        bWedgeClampingActive        := TRUE;
        tonWedgeRampTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1200MS);

        (* Cleave complete when crack reaches free edge (acoustic decay + dwell time) *)
        IF tonWedgeRampTimer.Q AND (rWedgeForceFeedback_N >= (rWedgeTargetForce_N * 0.85)) THEN
            tonWedgeRampTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 60; (* Advance to Post-Cleave Verification *)
        ELSIF tonStateTimer.Q THEN
            bSystemFaultTrip := TRUE;
            wDiagnosticAlarmWord.22 := TRUE; (* Bit 22: Mechanical Wedge Cleave Timeout *)
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    60: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 60: POST-CLEAVE SETTLING & EDGE INTEGRITY VERIFICATION
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0040; (* STATUS: POST-CLEAVE VERIFY *)
        bLaserEmissionEnable        := FALSE;
        bWedgeClampingActive        := FALSE;

        (* Verify residual acoustic quiescence and edge displacement *)
        IF (rAcousticEmission_mV < 15.0) THEN
            bCleaveCycleComplete    := TRUE;
            iState := 70; (* Transition to Unload & Axis Retraction *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 70: RETRACTION & CYCLE COMPLETION
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0080; (* STATUS: CYCLE COMPLETED *)
        bLaserEmissionEnable        := FALSE;
        bWedgeClampingActive        := FALSE;
        rPiezoCmdFiltered_um        := 50.0; (* Neutral center position *)

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            bCleaveCycleComplete    := FALSE;
            iState := 0; (* Re-arm to Idle Standby *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 99: CRITICAL SAFE STOP & BEAM EXTINCTION (SIL-3 FAIL-SAFE)
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#8000; (* STATUS: FAULT SHUTDOWN *)
        bLaserEmissionEnable        := FALSE;    (* Instantly drop laser hardware gate *)
        bWedgeClampingActive        := FALSE;    (* Instantly drop wedge actuator *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bCleaveCycleComplete        := FALSE;
        rPiezoFocusDrive_um         := 0.0;      (* Retract optical head to hard home *)
        rWedgeTensionDrive_N        := 0.0;      (* Zero voice-coil tension force *)
        
        (* Remain latched in State 99 until master reset rTrigReset occurs *)
END_CASE;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
